title: AeroBook Pro X14 Technical Specifications
body: The AeroBook Pro X14 laptop, model ANX-14, ships with 16 GB of RAM and a 512 GB solid-state drive.

title: AeroBook Pro X14 Battery Troubleshooting
body: If your AeroBook Pro X14 battery drains quickly or will not hold a charge, recalibrate it.

title: Resetting Your Password

title: SmartHub RX-450 Firmware Update

title: SmartHub Slow Wireless Troubleshooting
body: If video streams keep buffering or the wireless signal feels weak, move the SmartHub closer to your devices.
